label: dormwar13
title_zh: 第一次也是最后一次约会

lines.en: label dormwar13:
scene toukadate1
: Makoto Miyamura here, coming to you live from Viale dei Giapponesi, one of the most prestigious and {i}extremely{/i} expensive restaurants in all of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 我是 Makoto Miyamura，正在 Viale dei Giapponesi 为您现场报道——这里是全 Kumon-mi 最高档、也{i}最昂贵{/i}的餐厅之一。

lines.en: : What’s this? A pretend television show? How adorable.
lines.zh: : 这是什么？假装是电视节目？真可爱。

lines.en: : Hello, world! Bow down before Tsukasa Tsukioka, future emperor of Japan!
lines.zh: : 世界，你好！在 Tsukasa Tsukioka——未来的日本天皇——面前跪下吧！

lines.en: scene toukadate2
: Tsubasa, thank you very much for joining me today.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa，非常感谢你今天来参加。

lines.en: : Thank you for inviting me. It will be my daughter’s first ever date, and I need to be sure that my husband does not find out about it.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你邀请我。这将是我女儿有生以来第一次约会，而我得确保我丈夫不会知道。

lines.en: : Does your husband not approve of your daughter “dating?”
lines.zh: : 你丈夫不赞成你女儿“约会”吗？

lines.en: : Oh, heavens no. He wants Touka to follow in the family’s footsteps and have an arranged marriage like we did.
lines.zh: : 哦，天哪，当然不赞成。他希望 Touka 循着家族的足迹，像我们一样走包办婚姻。

lines.en: : And you {i}don’t{/i} support this?
lines.zh: : 那你{i}不{/i}认同这一点吗？

lines.en: : I just want my daughter to be happy and have the freedom she deserves.
lines.zh: : 我只希望我女儿幸福，拥有她应得的自由。

lines.en: : Which is also why we’ve rented out the entirety of the restaurant today.
lines.zh: : 这也是为什么我们今天把整家餐厅都包下来了。

lines.en: : Mother, can I go fire a chef?
lines.zh: : 母亲，我能去炒掉一个厨师吗？

lines.en: scene toukadate3
: Not right now, dear.
lines.zh: : 现在不行，亲爱的。

lines.en: : Pleeeeeeeeeease?
lines.zh: : 求————你了嘛？

lines.en: : Tsukasa...
lines.zh: : Tsukasa……

lines.en: : Later?
lines.zh: : 那待会儿呢？

lines.en: : We’ll see.
lines.zh: : 再说吧。

lines.en: scene toukadate2
: So, Tsubasa, since you’ve rented out the entire restaurant, is it safe to assume that money will be the driving force behind what makes this date a success in your eyes?
lines.zh: : 那么，Tsubasa，既然你把整家餐厅包了下来，是不是可以认为——在你看来，这场约会成功的主要推动力就是钱？

lines.en: : I’m sure it will play some role. But the true secret weapon is what’s on the inside.
lines.zh: : 我相信它会起到一定作用。但真正的秘密武器是内在的东西。

lines.en: : Meaning you think Touka’s attitude and feelings toward Sensei will be what gets her the win today?
lines.zh: : 你的意思是，你觉得 Touka 对 Sensei 的态度和感情，才是她今天取胜的关键？

lines.en: : Meaning she is wearing a dress that accentuates her natural beauty and that the atmosphere of the restaurant is unlike anything else I’ve ever seen.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，她身上那条裙子把她天生的美衬托得淋漓尽致，而这家餐厅的氛围也是我从未见过的。

lines.en: : But yes, she is also a lovely girl at heart as well.
lines.zh: : 不过没错，她内心也是个可爱的女孩。

lines.en: : I just hope that your teacher already being in a committed relationship does not cause the competition to be too one-sided.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望，你们的老师已经有了稳定的交往对象这件事，不会让这场比赛变得太一边倒。

lines.en: scene toukadate4
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Mother, when Touka gets married, can I have her second bedroom?
lines.zh: : 母亲，等 Touka 结婚了，我能要她的第二间卧室吗？

lines.en: : Ask your father, Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 去问你父亲，Tsukasa。

lines.en: scene black
I take a bus to the urban district after leaving Chika’s house to meet up with Touka.
lines.zh: 离开 Chika 家后，我搭巴士去市中心和 Touka 会合。

lines.en: I’ve already told Chika that she’s won the competition, so I imagine this “date” will be rather short.
lines.zh: 我已经告诉 Chika 她赢了这场比赛，所以我想这场“约会”应该会相当短暂。

lines.en: Not that I imagine Touka would agree to going on a date with me at this point anyway, so she was probably just tossed into this contest against her will.
lines.zh: 再说，我本来也不觉得 Touka 现在会答应跟我约会，所以她大概只是被硬塞进这场比赛的。

lines.en: But hey, I’m totally fine with that as it means I’ll probably be able to eat a lot of expensive food or-
lines.zh: 不过嘿，我完全无所谓，因为这意味着我大概能吃到很多昂贵的食物，或者——

lines.en: : Finally!
lines.zh: : 你可算来了！

lines.en: scene toukadate5
: Do you have any idea how long you’ve made me wait here?
lines.zh: : 你知道你让我在这儿等了多久吗？

lines.en: : I was beginning to think you weren’t going to show up at all.
lines.zh: : 我都开始以为你根本不会来了。

lines.en: What was I saying about Chika again?
lines.zh: 我刚才说 Chika 什么来着？

lines.en: : You look...very nice, Touka.
lines.zh: : 你看起来……非常漂亮，Touka。

lines.en: : And you look like you were never informed of this restaurant’s dress code.
lines.zh: : 而你看上去像是完全没被告知这家餐厅的着装要求。

lines.en: : To be honest, it wouldn’t have changed much even if I was. I only own two outfits.
lines.zh: : 说实话，就算被告知了也没什么区别。我总共只有两套衣服。

lines.en: scene toukadate6
: Two?! Isn’t that remarkably low for even...lower middle class standards?
lines.zh: : 两套？！就算按……中下阶层的标准，这也少得离谱了吧？

lines.en: : I’ve just never really needed any other clothes, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概只是因为我从来没真正需要过别的衣服吧。

lines.en: scene toukadate7
: I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: : May I ask how your date with Chika went?
lines.zh: : 我能问问你和 Chika 的约会怎么样吗？

lines.en: : She seemed rather excited to have the...opportunity today.
lines.zh: : 她今天看起来对得到这个……机会挺兴奋的。

lines.en: : And you’re not?
lines.zh: : 你不是吗？

lines.en: : Well...it’s not as if I {i}hate{/i} this.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我也没说{i}讨厌{/i}这个。

lines.en: : This is my favorite restaurant, after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟这是我最喜欢的餐厅。

lines.en: : And...I’ve never been on a date before, so that much is exciting.
lines.zh: : 而且……我从没约会过，所以这一点还是挺让人兴奋的。

lines.en: : I just expected to feel a little more...nervous, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 只是我以为自己会……更紧张一些吧。

lines.en: : Isn’t it good that you’re {i}not{/i} nervous? That just means you’re comfortable around me.
lines.zh: : 你不紧张{i}不是{/i}好事吗？那说明你跟我在一起很自在。

lines.en: scene toukadate8
: I can assure you that is absolutely not the case. You make me feel less comfortable than anyone I have ever met before.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，绝对不是这么回事。你让我比我这辈子见过的任何人都更不自在。

lines.en: : It’s just that...this entire ordeal feels so...staged, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 只是……这整件事感觉太……刻意了，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Well...it {i}is{/i} staged, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 嗯……它本来{i}就是{/i}刻意的，不是吗？

lines.en: : It is, yes. I didn’t even get to pick out my own clothes for the event.
lines.zh: : 是啊，确实是。我连这次的衣服都没能自己挑。

lines.en: : Well tell whoever did that I am very thankful.
lines.zh: : 那麻烦你替我谢谢挑衣服的人，我非常感激。

lines.en: : Please keep in mind that I am still your {i}student{/i} at the end of the day...And that if anything were to happen between us, it would make the headlines of several newspapers.
lines.zh: : 请记住，说到底我还是你的{i}学生{/i}……而且如果我们之间真发生了什么，那可是好几家报纸的头条。

lines.en: : I am not trying to have both of our reputations ruined in one fell swoop.
lines.zh: : 我可不想让我们俩的名声一下子全毁了。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I feel like it might be kind of worth it...
lines.zh: : 不好说。我觉得说不定挺值得的……

lines.en: scene toukadate9
: Can we just sit down? The two of us still standing here after introducing ourselves is likely making this date seem unsuccessful to our spectators.
lines.zh: : 我们能先坐下吗？打完招呼还站在这儿，大概会让我们这场约会在观众眼里显得很失败。

lines.en: : Spectators?
lines.zh: : 观众？

lines.en: : Good luck, dear!
lines.zh: : 祝你好运，亲爱的！

lines.en: : Ask him to teach you that game he played with the peasant girl! I still want to know!
lines.zh: : 让他教教你他跟那个平民女孩玩的那个游戏！我到现在还想知道！

lines.en: : Tsukasa, please sit down.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，请坐下。

lines.en: : I asked them not to come, but...
lines.zh: : 我叫她们别来的，可是……

lines.en: : Well, you see how that ended up.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你也看到结果了。

lines.en: : I...certainly do.
lines.zh: : 我……确实看到了。

lines.en: scene toukadate10
Touka and I sit down at the table and I quickly receive a reality check in that some [teenager]s grow up {i}way{/i} before others.
lines.zh: 我和 Touka 在桌边坐下，我很快就接受了现实的冲击——有些[teenager]就是比别人早熟{i}得多{/i}。

lines.en: I am going to have a very difficult time not staring at her tonight and I really wish her family was not here to observe that.
lines.zh: 今晚我要忍住不盯着她看会非常困难，而我真心希望她的家人没在这儿看着。

lines.en: : This...dorm war...
lines.zh: : 这场……宿舍大战……

lines.en: : What about it?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : It’s...fun.
lines.zh: : 挺……有意思的。

lines.en: : Does your class do things like this often?
lines.zh: : 你们班经常做这种事吗？

lines.en: : We’ve gone on trips to the beach and...had parties before. But there’s never been anything like this.
lines.zh: : 我们以前去过海边旅行，也……办过派对。但从没有过像这样的。

lines.en: : Are you actually starting to get along with people now?
lines.zh: : 你现在真的开始跟大家相处得来了？

lines.en: scene toukadate11
: Slowly, but...I think so.
lines.zh: : 慢慢地……不过我觉得是的。

lines.en: : And I was a bit hesitant to accept {i}this{/i} particular challenge for that exact reason.
lines.zh: : 也正是因为这个，我一开始才有点犹豫要不要接下{i}这个{/i}项目。

lines.en: : Yeah, I was thinking you may have been forced into this somehow.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我还以为你是被硬塞进来的。

lines.en: : I wasn’t {i}forced{/i}. You’re incorrigible, but I don’t despise you.
lines.zh: : 我没有被{i}强迫{/i}。你无可救药，但我并不讨厌你。

lines.en: : I just would have preferred something a bit more...girl-oriented so as to not paint yet another target on my back.
lines.zh: : 我只是更希望来个稍微……女孩子气一点的项目，免得又在我背上多画一个靶子。

lines.en: : Something like...the Nagasawa girl’s test of knowledge. Or the tomboyish girl...umm...Miku, I think? Her contest.
lines.zh: : 比如……Nagasawa 家那个女孩的知识竞赛。或者是那个假小子……嗯……Miku 吧？她的那个项目。

lines.en: : You think you’d fare well in an athletics test?
lines.zh: : 你觉得自己在运动项目上能有好表现？

lines.en: : You think I wouldn’t?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我不行？

lines.en: : I think there are two large obstacles that would prevent you from moving the same way someone like Miku does.
lines.zh: : 我觉得有两大障碍，会让你没法像 Miku 那样活动。

lines.en: : Obstacles? There are very few obstacles for the Tsukioka family and-
lines.zh: : 障碍？对 Tsukioka 家来说障碍少之又少，而且——

lines.en: : Oh. I get it.
lines.zh: : 哦。我懂了。

lines.en: : I’m glad I didn’t have to say anything.
lines.zh: : 很高兴不用我说出口。

lines.en: scene toukadate12
: I’m also quite glad you didn’t say anything. I am well aware of the hindrances my body may cause on occasion.
lines.zh: : 我也挺高兴你没说。我很清楚我这副身体有时候会造成怎样的阻碍。

lines.en: scene toukadate13
: Like...right now, for example. You’re already starting to zone out, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 比如说……现在。你已经开始走神了，对吧？

lines.en: : Hm? What was that?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你说什么？

lines.en: : You are becoming more and more predictable with each passing day, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你一天比一天好猜了。

lines.en: : Before you know it, you’ll be opening your door before I even knock.
lines.zh: : 不知不觉间，你大概会在我敲门之前就把门打开。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine a day like that coming any time soon.
lines.zh: : 我想那一天短期内是不会来的。

lines.en: : Yeah. Probably not until after our third date, I’d imagine.
lines.zh: : 是啊。大概要等到我们第三次约会之后吧。

lines.en: scene toukadate14
: Hehe~ I was thinking more the...tenth or eleventh.
lines.zh: : 呵呵~我觉得更像是……第十次或者第十一次。

lines.en: : Looks like we’ll be going on a lot of dates from now on, huh?
lines.zh: : 看来从今往后我们要约会很多次啊。

lines.en: scene toukadate15
: I can’t say I blame you for wanting to get closer to me, but I would like to remind you that this is not a real date and that I never would have agreed to go if it was.
lines.zh: : 你想跟我更亲近，我倒也不能怪你，不过我得提醒你，这不是真正的约会，如果是的话我也绝不会答应。

lines.en: : Never?
lines.zh: : 绝不？

lines.en: : Probably never.
lines.zh: : 大概绝不会。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I’ll just schedule a few more fake ones with your mom and see what else she’s willing to make you wear.
lines.zh: : 没关系。那我就再跟你妈妈安排几场假的，看看她还愿意让你穿什么。

lines.en: scene toukadate16
: Please don’t do that. I actually detest being fitted for new clothes, and she would never approve of me wearing the same thing to multiple outings.
lines.zh: : 请别这样。我其实很讨厌试新衣服，而且她绝不会同意我多次出门穿同一件。

lines.en: : Besides, occasions like this are meant to be shared between either lovers or those with the potential to find love in one another.
lines.zh: : 再说，这样的场合本该属于恋人，或者有可能彼此找到爱的人。

lines.en: : There is no reason for the two of us to do things like this together when the likelihood of us remaining in contact after I graduate is slim to none.
lines.zh: : 既然我毕业后我们还能保持联系的可能性几乎为零，那我们两个根本没理由一起做这种事。

lines.en: : Good thing you won’t be graduating any time soon.
lines.zh: : 幸好你还不会马上毕业。

lines.en: scene toukadate17
: No...I suppose I won’t be. There are still several years left of [high_school].
lines.zh: : 不……我想是不会。我的[high_school]还剩好几年呢。

lines.en: There are a lot more than just “several,” Touka...
lines.zh: 可远不止“好几”年啊，Touka……

lines.en: : It’s important to always look toward the future, though. Especially for someone like me, whose path is already laid out.
lines.zh: : 不过，永远向前看是很重要的。尤其是对我这样道路早已被铺好的人。

lines.en: : So it would probably be best if we called this date our last.
lines.zh: : 所以，我们大概最好把这场约会当作最后一次。

lines.en: : We can chat and make merry for the rest of the night, but once this is over, I’d like to go back to focusing on my studies.
lines.zh: : 今晚剩下的时间我们可以聊天、尽兴，但等这一切结束，我想重新把重心放回学业上。

lines.en: : That {i}is{/i} why I came here after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟我到这儿来{i}就是{/i}为了这个。

lines.en: : Why you came and why you continue to come are two different things, though.
lines.zh: : 可你为什么来，和你为什么一直来，是两回事。

lines.en: : You still show up to class every day and I haven’t done much to advance your studies yet, have I?
lines.zh: : 你每天都来上课，而我在推进你的学业上也没做什么，对吧？

lines.en: scene toukadate18
: That is no fault of my own.
lines.zh: : 那可不是我的错。

lines.en: : But you still come.
lines.zh: : 可你还是来了。

lines.en: : Because it is my duty to-
lines.zh: : 因为那是我的义务——

lines.en: : You come see me every morning. You even say hello to me as soon as you walk in.
lines.zh: : 你每天早上都来看我。你一进门就跟我打招呼。

lines.en: scene toukadate19
: Because it would be impolite if I were to just walk by you without-
lines.zh: : 因为如果我从你身边走过去连招呼都——

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} think you keep coming to class because you’re starting to like me.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}觉得你一直来上课，是因为你开始喜欢我了。

lines.en: scene toukadate20
: You-
: Take that back! I am not!
lines.zh: : 收回那句话！我才没有！

lines.en: : You are...adequate as a teacher! But I still have yet to feel the full effect of your methods on my testing and-
lines.zh: : 你作为老师……算是合格！但我还没完全感受到你的方法对我考试成绩的作用，而且——

lines.en: : You don’t...{i}love{/i} me, do you?
lines.zh: : 你……不{i}爱{/i}我吧？

lines.en: scene toukadate21
: Mother! Some assistance, please?!
lines.zh: : 母亲！请帮帮忙好吗？！

lines.en: : You’re doing wonderfully, dear! He’ll be eating foie gras out of your palm within the hour.
lines.zh: : 你做得非常好，亲爱的！不出一个小时，他就会从你手心里吃鹅肝了。

lines.en: : That is disgusting! Please come to the table and teach him how he should be-
lines.zh: : 太恶心了！请过来教教他该怎么——

lines.en: : Touka, hold on a second.
lines.zh: : Touka，等一下。

lines.en: scene toukadate22
: ...What?
: You used my real name, so...it must be at least mildly important.
lines.zh: : 你叫了我的本名，所以……应该至少有点重要。

lines.en: : First of all, I’m just messing with you. I know you don’t {i}love{/i} me.
lines.zh: : 首先，我刚才是逗你的。我知道你不{i}爱{/i}我。
: 然后呢？……

lines.en: : And...that’s why I already told Chika that this victory goes to her.
lines.zh: : 然后……所以我已经告诉 Chika，这场胜利归她。

lines.en: scene toukadate23
: Hah...you could have at least waited until we were finished with dinner to inform me of that.
lines.zh: : 哈……你至少可以等我们吃完晚饭再告诉我这件事。

lines.en: : It’s just that-
lines.zh: : 只是——

lines.en: : Yes, yes. A fancy meal and a nice dress means nothing without actual romantic chemistry.
lines.zh: : 好好好。没有真正的恋爱化学反应，再丰盛的大餐、再漂亮的裙子都毫无意义。

lines.en: : I am not {i}entirely{/i} naive, Sensei. I expected Chika to win from the moment this outing was decided.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我可没{i}那么{/i}天真。从这次外出定下来的那一刻起，我就料到 Chika 会赢。

lines.en: scene toukadate24
: And yet...I came.
lines.zh: : 可我还是……来了。

lines.en: : Just like I do with class.
lines.zh: : 就像我去上课一样。

lines.en: scene toukadate25
: You irritate me to no end.
lines.zh: : 你烦死我了。

lines.en: : And yes, I may have tried to get you fired on several occasions now for completely disregarding your responsibilities-
lines.zh: : 没错，我确实有几次因为你完全无视自己的职责而想让你被开除——

lines.en: : But still, I show up every morning and greet you.
lines.zh: : 可我还是每天早上出现，跟你打招呼。

lines.en: : It is not because I like you, though.
lines.zh: : 不过那不是因为我喜欢你。

lines.en: : What is it then?
lines.zh: : 那是因为什么？

lines.en: : Is it actually-
lines.zh: : 难道真的是——

lines.en: : If you say “love” I will snap my fingers and have my assassins jump right out from behind the bar.
lines.zh: : 你要是敢说“爱”，我就打个响指，让我的刺客从吧台后面跳出来。

lines.en: : I knew I heard something back there...
lines.zh: : 我就知道那边有什么动静……

lines.en: : The reason I continue to show up is that I need your help.
lines.zh: : 我继续出现的原因，是我需要你的帮助。

lines.en: : It wasn’t until I joined your class that I knew what it was like to be among other girls my age.
lines.zh: : 直到进了你的班，我才知道和同龄女孩在一起是什么感觉。

lines.en: : And it wasn’t until I joined your class that I knew how it felt to look at myself in the mirror before going out to eat with a boy.
lines.zh: : 直到进了你的班，我才知道出门和一个男生吃饭前照镜子是什么心情。

lines.en: : I’ve had many firsts in such a short period of time, and it is all thanks to you.
lines.zh: : 在这么短的时间里，我经历了那么多第一次，而这一切都要感谢你。

lines.en: : Well...maybe not {i}all{/i} thanks to you. But you have played somewhat of an important role in the matter.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许不{i}全{/i}是因为你。但你在这件事里确实起了相当重要的作用。

lines.en: scene toukadate26
: So I accept my defeat at the hands of Chika Chosokabe...
lines.zh: : 所以，我承认败给了 Chika Chosokabe……

lines.en: : But I do ask that you continue to annoy me for a little while longer.
lines.zh: : 不过我确实希望你能再烦我一段时间。

lines.en: : Oh dear. I think I’m tearing up.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。我好像要哭了。

lines.en: : Tsukasa, darling. Could you fetch me a box of tissues from the kitchen?
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，亲爱的。你能去厨房给我拿盒纸巾吗？

lines.en: : Yes, Mother. But there will be one less chef after I return.
lines.zh: : 好的，母亲。不过等我回来，就会少一个厨师。

lines.en: : That’s fine...just...{i}*sniff*{/i}...hurry up.
lines.zh: : 没关系……只是……{i}*抽泣*{/i}……快去。

lines.en: scene black
The waitress arrives the moment we stop talking and takes our orders.
lines.zh: 我们一停下话头，女服务员就过来点单了。

lines.en: I try to order something myself but am unable to pronounce it properly, so Touka takes charge and says a bunch of stuff in what I’m pretty sure is Italian on my behalf.
lines.zh: 我试着自己点菜，可怎么也念不对，于是 Touka 接过话头，替我说了一大串我猜是意大利语的东西。

lines.en: We don’t talk much at all for the rest of the date, but it’s somehow not bad.
lines.zh: 这场约会剩下的时间里我们几乎没怎么说话，但不知为何并不糟糕。

lines.en: It doesn’t really feel like...anything, though.
lines.zh: 不过它真的……什么感觉都没有。

lines.en: Just another meeting at a table with a girl who is far too good for me.
lines.zh: 只是又一次坐在桌边，和一个我远远配不上的女孩见面。
